title: The Endless Frontier read as working back from airdropped alien tech

tellings.quote: if you think if you read the endless frontier with this new lens of like maybe we have derivative alien technology

plain: Michels suggests that Science, The Endless Frontier, the 1945 report by the American science administrator Vannevar Bush that set out how the US government should fund research after the war, reads differently "with this new lens": as a plan for working back from derivative alien technology the government already had. This is Michels' own reading, offered without a further source. The report lays out a programme of government-funded science; whether anything behind it came from recovered craft, it neither says nor rules out, and Michels does not quote it on that point.
